```{r helpers}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) y else x
clean <- function(x) {
  z <- trimws(as.character(x))
  z[toupper(z) %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL", "<MISSING>", "NAN")] <- NA_character_
  z
}
softmax <- function(z) { z <- z - max(z); exp(z) / sum(exp(z)) }
js <- function(y, q) {
  if (sum(y) <= 0 || sum(q) <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  p <- y / sum(y); q <- q / sum(q); m <- (p + q) / 2
  a <- which(p > 0); b <- which(q > 0)
  0.5 * (sum(p[a] * log(p[a] / m[a])) + sum(q[b] * log(q[b] / m[b])))
}
pair_js <- function(Y, ii, jj) {
  P <- Y / rowSums(Y)
  a <- P[ii, , drop = FALSE]; b <- P[jj, , drop = FALSE]; m <- (a + b) / 2
  rowSums(a * log(pmax(a, 1e-300) / pmax(m, 1e-300)) +
          b * log(pmax(b, 1e-300) / pmax(m, 1e-300))) / 2
}
q3 <- function(z) {
  z <- z[is.finite(z)]
  if (!length(z)) return(c(lo = NA_real_, med = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_))
  setNames(as.numeric(stats::quantile(z, c(.025, .5, .975), names = FALSE)),
           c("lo", "med", "hi"))
}
position_in_range <- function(obs, lo, hi) {
  ifelse(!is.finite(obs) | !is.finite(lo) | !is.finite(hi), "NA",
         ifelse(obs < lo, "below", ifelse(obs > hi, "above", "within")))
}
phase_factor <- function(x) factor(as.character(x), levels = PHASES)
wrap_label <- function(x, width = 14L) {
  vapply(as.character(x), function(s) paste(strwrap(s, width = width), collapse = "\n"),
         character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 4L) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  out <- rep("NA", length(x))
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  int_like <- ok & abs(x - round(x)) < 1e-9 & abs(x) < 1e12
  out[int_like] <- sprintf("%.0f", round(x[int_like]))
  dec <- ok & !int_like
  out[dec] <- trimws(formatC(x[dec], digits = digits, format = "g"))
  inf <- !ok & !is.na(x)
  out[inf] <- as.character(x[inf])
  out
}
interval_text <- function(lo, hi, digits = 4L) paste(fmt_num(lo, digits), "to", fmt_num(hi, digits))
theme_report <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8), axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 4))
}
latex_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("([&%$#_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x)
  x <- gsub("~", "\\textasciitilde{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^", "\\textasciicircum{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
latex_table <- function(df, total = 0.92, chars_per_line = 90) {
  m <- as.matrix(df); storage.mode(m) <- "character"; m[is.na(m)] <- "NA"
  cells <- rbind(names(df), m)
  words <- apply(cells, 2, function(col)
    max(nchar(unlist(strsplit(col, "[[:space:]]+"))), 1L))
  avg <- apply(cells, 2, function(col) mean(nchar(col)))
  base <- words + 1
  spare <- max(0, chars_per_line - sum(base))
  extra <- pmax(avg - base, 0)
  w <- base + if (sum(extra) > 0) spare * extra / sum(extra) else spare / length(base)
  w <- w / sum(w) * total
  spec <- paste0("@{}", paste0(">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{", sprintf("%.3f", w),
                               "\\linewidth}", collapse = ""), "@{}")
  body <- matrix(latex_escape(m), nrow = nrow(m))
  rows <- apply(body, 1, function(r) paste0(paste(r, collapse = " & "), " \\\\"))
  c("\\begingroup\\small", "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}",
    paste0("\\begin{longtable}{", spec, "}"), "\\toprule",
    paste0(paste(latex_escape(names(df)), collapse = " & "), " \\\\"), "\\midrule",
    "\\endhead", "\\bottomrule", "\\endlastfoot", rows, "\\end{longtable}", "\\endgroup")
}
print_table <- function(df) {
  if (isTRUE(knitr::is_latex_output())) {
    cat("\n", paste(latex_table(df), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("\n\n"); print(knitr::kable(df, format = "pipe")); cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r parallel-setup}
logical_processors <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE)))
if (!is.finite(logical_processors) || logical_processors < 1L) logical_processors <- 2L
CPU_WORKERS <- if (isTRUE(RUN_PARALLEL)) {
  max(1L, min(as.integer(MAX_WORKERS), logical_processors - 1L))
} else 1L
WORKER_OBJECTS <- c("SEED")
worker_function_names <- function() {
  nms <- ls(envir = .knit_env)
  nms[vapply(nms, function(n) is.function(get(n, envir = .knit_env)), logical(1))]
}
parallel_map <- function(X, FUN, ..., exports = character(), workers = CPU_WORKERS) {
  if (length(X) < 2L || !isTRUE(RUN_PARALLEL) || workers < 2L) return(lapply(X, FUN, ...))
  n <- min(as.integer(workers), length(X))
  cl <- tryCatch(parallel::makeCluster(n, type = "PSOCK"),
                 error = function(e) {
                   warning("PSOCK unavailable; serial fallback: ", conditionMessage(e))
                   NULL
                 })
  if (is.null(cl)) return(lapply(X, FUN, ...))
  on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
  parallel::clusterCall(cl, function() {
    Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
               MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1", BLIS_NUM_THREADS = "1")
    invisible(NULL)
  })
  objs <- unique(c(worker_function_names(), WORKER_OBJECTS, exports))
  objs <- objs[vapply(objs, exists, logical(1), envir = .knit_env, inherits = FALSE)]
  parallel::clusterExport(cl, objs, envir = .knit_env)
  parallel::parLapply(cl, X, FUN, ...)
}
replicate_blocks <- function(B, blocks = PARALLEL_BLOCKS) {
  stopifnot(length(B) == 1L, B >= 1L)
  split(seq_len(B), rep(seq_len(min(B, blocks)), length.out = B))
}
parallel_simulate <- function(B, step, base_seed, nmetrics, exports = character()) {
  tasks <- replicate_blocks(B)
  result <- parallel_map(tasks, function(ids, step_fn, seed0, p) {
    ans <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ids), ncol = p)
    for (j in seq_along(ids)) {
      set.seed(seed0 + ids[j])
      v <- as.numeric(step_fn(ids[j]))
      if (length(v) != p || any(!is.finite(v))) stop("Invalid Monte Carlo statistic")
      ans[j, ] <- v
    }
    list(ids = ids, values = ans)
  }, step_fn = step, seed0 = as.integer(base_seed), p = as.integer(nmetrics),
  exports = exports)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B, ncol = nmetrics)
  for (a in result) out[a$ids, ] <- a$values
  if (anyNA(out)) stop("Parallel simulations returned incomplete statistics")
  out
}
```

```{r data}
load_github_layer <- function(name) {
  holder <- new.env()
  loaded <- load(url(paste0(GITHUB_RDATA, "/", name, ".RData")), envir = holder)
  if (!identical(loaded, name)) stop(name, ".RData must contain only the object ", name)
  obj <- get(name, envir = holder)
  if (!inherits(obj, "sf")) stop(name, " is not an sf object")
  obj
}
ceramics <- load_github_layer("AAS_CERAMICS")
survey <- load_github_layer("AAS_POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO")
for (nm in c("ceramics", "survey")) {
  obj <- get(nm)
  if (is.na(sf::st_crs(obj)$epsg) || sf::st_crs(obj)$epsg != 32618L)
    stop(nm, " must use EPSG:32618")
  if (any(sf::st_is_empty(obj)) || !all(sf::st_is_valid(obj) %in% TRUE))
    stop(nm, ": invalid or empty geometry")
}
if (!all(as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(ceramics)) == "POINT"))
  stop("AAS_CERAMICS must contain POINT geometries")
needed <- c("UTM_East", "UTM_North", "Ceramic_ty", "Period", "Diam_Terra")
if (length(setdiff(needed, names(ceramics))))
  stop("AAS_CERAMICS lacks: ", paste(setdiff(needed, names(ceramics)), collapse = ", "))
if (nrow(ceramics) != EXPECTED_FRAGMENTS)
  warning("Fragment count differs from ", EXPECTED_FRAGMENTS)
raw <- sf::st_drop_geometry(ceramics) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Period = clean(Period), Ceramic_ty = clean(Ceramic_ty),
                Diam_Terra = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Diam_Terra))) |>
  dplyr::group_by(UTM_East, UTM_North) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Terrace_ID = sprintf("T%04d", dplyr::cur_group_id())) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  as.data.frame()
if (anyNA(raw$UTM_East) || anyNA(raw$UTM_North)) stop("Missing terrace coordinates")
if (anyNA(raw$Diam_Terra)) stop("Missing Diam_Terra values")
if (any(tapply(raw$Diam_Terra, raw$Terrace_ID, function(z) length(unique(z))) != 1L))
  stop("Diam_Terra is not constant within terraces")
if (dplyr::n_distinct(raw$Terrace_ID) != EXPECTED_TERRACES)
  warning("Number of terrace coordinates differs from ", EXPECTED_TERRACES)
terraces <- raw |>
  dplyr::group_by(Terrace_ID, UTM_East, UTM_North) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Diam_Terra = dplyr::first(Diam_Terra), Fragments_all = dplyr::n(),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  as.data.frame()
terraces$Terrace_class <- factor(
  ifelse(terraces$Diam_Terra <= CLASS_UPPER_M[["Small"]], "Small",
         ifelse(terraces$Diam_Terra <= CLASS_UPPER_M[["Standard"]], "Standard", "Large")),
  levels = CLASS_LEVELS)
pts <- sf::st_as_sf(terraces, coords = c("UTM_East", "UTM_North"), crs = 32618,
                    remove = FALSE)
survey_union <- sf::st_union(survey)
terraces$Inside_survey <- as.vector(sf::st_within(pts, survey_union, sparse = FALSE))
if (any(!terraces$Inside_survey))
  warning(sum(!terraces$Inside_survey), " terraces fall outside the survey polygon")
cer <- raw[raw$Period %in% PHASES & !is.na(raw$Ceramic_ty), ]
if (any(!startsWith(cer$Ceramic_ty, paste0(cer$Period, " "))))
  warning("Some type names do not begin with their phase")
make_phase <- function(ph) {
  z <- cer[cer$Period == ph, ] |> dplyr::count(Terrace_ID, Ceramic_ty, name = "count")
  labs <- sort(unique(z$Ceramic_ty))
  wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(z, names_from = Ceramic_ty, values_from = count,
                             values_fill = 0L)
  Y <- as.matrix(wide[, labs, drop = FALSE]); storage.mode(Y) <- "integer"
  meta <- terraces[match(wide$Terrace_ID, terraces$Terrace_ID), ]
  rownames(meta) <- NULL
  if (anyNA(Y) || any(rowSums(Y) == 0L) || anyNA(meta$Terrace_ID))
    stop("Phase matrix failed checks: ", ph)
  list(phase = ph, Y = Y, meta = meta, type_labels = labs, n = nrow(Y))
}
phase_data <- setNames(lapply(PHASES, make_phase), PHASES)
diam_freq <- as.data.frame(table(Diameter_m = terraces$Diam_Terra), responseName = "Terraces")
centre_distance <- as.matrix(stats::dist(cbind(terraces$UTM_East, terraces$UTM_North)))
OVERLAP_MATRIX <- centre_distance < outer(terraces$Diam_Terra, terraces$Diam_Terra, "+") / 2
diag(OVERLAP_MATRIX) <- FALSE
dimnames(OVERLAP_MATRIX) <- list(terraces$Terrace_ID, terraces$Terrace_ID)
```

```{r models}
multinom_loglik <- function(Y, p) {
  p <- pmax(p, 1e-12); p <- p / sum(p)
  sum(lgamma(rowSums(Y) + 1) - rowSums(lgamma(Y + 1)) + as.vector(Y %*% log(p)))
}
multinom_loglik_rows <- function(Y, p) {
  p <- pmax(p, 1e-12); p <- p / sum(p)
  lgamma(rowSums(Y) + 1) - rowSums(lgamma(Y + 1)) + as.vector(Y %*% log(p))
}
dm_loglik <- function(Y, p, phi) {
  if (!is.finite(phi) || phi <= 0) return(-Inf)
  p <- pmax(p, 1e-12); p <- p / sum(p)
  a <- phi * p
  sum(lgamma(rowSums(Y) + 1) - rowSums(lgamma(Y + 1)) +
      lgamma(phi) - lgamma(phi + rowSums(Y)) +
      rowSums(sweep(lgamma(sweep(Y, 2, a, "+")), 2, lgamma(a), "-")))
}
dm_loglik_rows <- function(Y, p, phi) {
  if (!is.finite(phi) || phi <= 0) return(rep(-Inf, nrow(Y)))
  p <- pmax(p, 1e-12); p <- p / sum(p)
  a <- phi * p
  lgamma(rowSums(Y) + 1) - rowSums(lgamma(Y + 1)) +
    lgamma(phi) - lgamma(phi + rowSums(Y)) +
    rowSums(sweep(lgamma(sweep(Y, 2, a, "+")), 2, lgamma(a), "-"))
}
dm_loglik_rows_P <- function(Y, P, phi) {
  if (!is.finite(phi) || phi <= 0) return(rep(-Inf, nrow(Y)))
  P <- pmax(P, 1e-12); P <- P / rowSums(P)
  A <- phi * P; n <- rowSums(Y)
  lgamma(n + 1) - rowSums(lgamma(Y + 1)) + lgamma(phi) - lgamma(phi + n) +
    rowSums(lgamma(Y + A) - lgamma(A))
}
fit_m0 <- function(Y) {
  p <- (colSums(Y) + 1e-9) / sum(colSums(Y) + 1e-9)
  ll <- multinom_loglik(Y, p)
  list(p = p, ll = ll, npar = ncol(Y) - 1L, aic = -2 * ll + 2 * (ncol(Y) - 1L),
       converged = TRUE)
}
fit_dm <- function(Y, maxit = 1200L) {
  if (nrow(Y) < 3L || ncol(Y) < 2L) return(NULL)
  K <- ncol(Y)
  p0 <- (colSums(Y) + 0.5) / (sum(Y) + 0.5 * K)
  start <- c(log(p0[-K] / p0[K]), log(12))
  fn <- function(z) {
    x <- dm_loglik(Y, softmax(c(z[seq_len(K - 1)], 0)), exp(z[K]))
    if (!is.finite(x)) 1e100 else -x
  }
  f <- tryCatch(stats::optim(start, fn, method = "L-BFGS-B",
                             lower = c(rep(-14, K - 1), log(.03)),
                             upper = c(rep(14, K - 1), log(1e7)),
                             control = list(maxit = maxit)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
  ll <- -f$value
  list(p = softmax(c(f$par[seq_len(K - 1)], 0)), phi = exp(f$par[K]), ll = ll, npar = K,
       aic = -2 * ll + 2 * K, converged = f$convergence == 0L)
}
fit_dm_class <- function(Y, cls, maxit = 2000L) {
  cls <- droplevels(factor(cls))
  lev <- levels(cls); C <- length(lev); K <- ncol(Y)
  if (C < 2L || nrow(Y) < 3L) return(NULL)
  idx <- as.integer(cls)
  rows_by_class <- lapply(seq_len(C), function(g) which(idx == g))
  D <- C * (K - 1L) + 1L
  start <- numeric(D)
  for (g in seq_len(C)) {
    pg <- (colSums(Y[rows_by_class[[g]], , drop = FALSE]) + 0.5) /
      (sum(Y[rows_by_class[[g]], , drop = FALSE]) + 0.5 * K)
    start[(g - 1L) * (K - 1L) + seq_len(K - 1L)] <- log(pg[-K] / pg[K])
  }
  start[D] <- log(12)
  fn <- function(z) {
    phi <- exp(z[D]); tot <- 0
    for (g in seq_len(C)) {
      p <- softmax(c(z[(g - 1L) * (K - 1L) + seq_len(K - 1L)], 0))
      tot <- tot + dm_loglik(Y[rows_by_class[[g]], , drop = FALSE], p, phi)
    }
    if (!is.finite(tot)) 1e100 else -tot
  }
  f <- tryCatch(stats::optim(start, fn, method = "L-BFGS-B",
                             lower = c(rep(-14, D - 1L), log(.03)),
                             upper = c(rep(14, D - 1L), log(1e7)),
                             control = list(maxit = maxit)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
  P <- t(vapply(seq_len(C), function(g)
    softmax(c(f$par[(g - 1L) * (K - 1L) + seq_len(K - 1L)], 0)), numeric(K)))
  rownames(P) <- lev
  ll <- -f$value
  list(P = P, classes = lev, phi = exp(f$par[D]), ll = ll, npar = D, aic = -2 * ll + 2 * D,
       converged = f$convergence == 0L)
}
predict_m1t <- function(fit_t, fit_1, teY, te_class) {
  n <- nrow(teY)
  if (is.null(fit_t) || !isTRUE(fit_t$converged) || is.null(fit_1))
    return(list(ll = rep(NA_real_, n), unseen = rep(NA, n)))
  cls <- as.character(te_class)
  seen <- cls %in% fit_t$classes
  ll <- dm_loglik_rows(teY, fit_1$p, fit_1$phi)
  if (any(seen)) {
    P <- fit_t$P[cls[seen], , drop = FALSE]
    ll[seen] <- dm_loglik_rows_P(teY[seen, , drop = FALSE], P, fit_t$phi)
  }
  list(ll = ll, unseen = !seen)
}
rdm <- function(n, p, phi) {
  z <- stats::rgamma(length(p), shape = pmax(p * phi, 1e-9), rate = 1)
  if (!is.finite(sum(z)) || sum(z) <= 0) z <- p
  as.integer(stats::rmultinom(1, n, z / sum(z))[, 1])
}
sim_m0 <- function(ns, p) {
  t(vapply(ns, function(n) as.integer(stats::rmultinom(1, n, p)[, 1]), integer(length(p))))
}
sim_m1 <- function(ns, p, phi) {
  t(vapply(ns, function(n) rdm(n, p, phi), integer(length(p))))
}
sim_m1t <- function(ns, cls, P, phi) {
  t(vapply(seq_along(ns), function(i) rdm(ns[i], P[cls[i], ], phi), integer(ncol(P))))
}
nn_index <- function(x, y, k = 1L) {
  d <- sqrt(outer(x, x, "-")^2 + outer(y, y, "-")^2)
  diag(d) <- Inf
  res <- apply(d, 1, function(r) order(r)[seq_len(k)])
  if (k == 1L) matrix(res, ncol = 1L) else t(res)
}
nn_divergence <- function(Y, nn) {
  k <- ncol(nn)
  mean(pair_js(Y, rep(seq_len(nrow(Y)), each = k), as.vector(t(nn))))
}
fits <- lapply(phase_data, function(o)
  list(M0 = fit_m0(o$Y), M1 = fit_dm(o$Y), M1T = fit_dm_class(o$Y, o$meta$Terrace_class)))
```

```{r bootstrap}
boot_phase <- function(ph) {
  o <- phase_data[[ph]]; Y <- o$Y; cls <- droplevels(o$meta$Terrace_class)
  groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(Y)), cls)
  step <- function(b) {
    idx <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) g[sample.int(length(g), length(g), replace = TRUE)]),
                  use.names = FALSE)
    f1 <- fit_dm(Y[idx, , drop = FALSE])
    ft <- fit_dm_class(Y[idx, , drop = FALSE], cls[idx])
    c(if (!is.null(f1) && isTRUE(f1$converged)) f1$phi else -1,
      if (!is.null(ft) && isTRUE(ft$converged)) ft$phi else -1)
  }
  parallel_simulate(N_BOOT, step, SEED + 4400L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)), 2L)
}
boot_results <- setNames(lapply(PHASES, boot_phase), PHASES)
boot_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(PHASES, function(ph) {
  b <- boot_results[[ph]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:2, function(j) {
    v <- b[, j]; ok <- v > 0; q <- q3(v[ok])
    data.frame(Phase = ph, Model = c("M1", "M1T")[j], Bootstrap_fits = length(v),
               Converged = sum(ok), Concentration_q025 = q[["lo"]],
               Concentration_median = q[["med"]], Concentration_q975 = q[["hi"]],
               ICC_q025 = 1 / (1 + q[["hi"]]), ICC_q975 = 1 / (1 + q[["lo"]]))
  }))
}))
```

```{r fig2-compute}
rarefied_richness <- function(y, m) {
  N <- sum(y)
  if (N < m) return(NA_real_)
  sum(1 - exp(lchoose(N - y, m) - lchoose(N, m)))
}
fig2_phase <- function(ph) {
  o <- phase_data[[ph]]
  keep <- which(rowSums(o$Y) >= RAREFACTION_DEPTH)
  depths <- seq_len(RAREFACTION_DEPTH)
  if (length(keep) < 2L) return(NULL)
  R <- t(vapply(keep, function(i) vapply(depths, function(m) rarefied_richness(o$Y[i, ], m),
                                         numeric(1)), numeric(length(depths))))
  step <- function(b) {
    rr <- sample.int(nrow(R), nrow(R), replace = TRUE)
    apply(R[rr, , drop = FALSE], 2, stats::median)
  }
  boot <- parallel_simulate(N_BOOT, step, SEED + 2200L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)), length(depths))
  data.frame(Phase = ph, Depth = depths, Median = apply(R, 2, stats::median),
             Boot_low = apply(boot, 2, stats::quantile, probs = .025),
             Boot_high = apply(boot, 2, stats::quantile, probs = .975),
             Types = ncol(o$Y), Terraces = length(keep))
}
```

```{r fig3-compute}
fig3_phase <- function(ph) {
  o <- phase_data[[ph]]; f <- fits[[ph]]
  Y <- o$Y; ns <- rowSums(Y); ref <- f$M0$p
  stat_fun <- function(yy) mean(apply(yy, 1, js, q = ref))
  observed <- stat_fun(Y)
  p0 <- f$M0$p; p1 <- f$M1$p; phi1 <- f$M1$phi
  has_t <- !is.null(f$M1T) && isTRUE(f$M1T$converged)
  Pt <- if (has_t) f$M1T$P else NULL
  phit <- if (has_t) f$M1T$phi else NA_real_
  cls <- as.character(o$meta$Terrace_class)
  step <- function(b) {
    out <- c(stat_fun(sim_m0(ns, p0)), stat_fun(sim_m1(ns, p1, phi1)))
    if (has_t) out <- c(out, stat_fun(sim_m1t(ns, cls, Pt, phit)))
    out
  }
  models <- if (has_t) c("M0", "M1", "M1T") else c("M0", "M1")
  sims <- parallel_simulate(N_SIM, step, SEED + 3300L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)), length(models))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(models), function(mi) {
    v <- sims[, mi]; q <- q3(v)
    data.frame(Phase = ph, Model = models[mi], Observed = observed, Sim_median = q[["med"]],
               Sim_q025 = q[["lo"]], Sim_q975 = q[["hi"]],
               Share_sims_at_or_below = mean(v <= observed),
               Position = position_in_range(observed, q[["lo"]], q[["hi"]]))
  }))
}
fig3d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(PHASES, fig3_phase))
fig3d$Phase <- phase_factor(fig3d$Phase)
fig3d$Model <- factor(fig3d$Model, levels = c("M0", "M1", "M1T"))
fig3_obs <- unique(fig3d[, c("Phase", "Observed")])
```

```{r fig4-compute}
fig4_phase <- function(ph) {
  o <- phase_data[[ph]]; Y <- o$Y; K <- ncol(Y)
  cls <- droplevels(o$meta$Terrace_class); lev <- levels(cls)
  groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(Y)), cls)
  comp <- function(idx) {
    Yc <- Y[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    c(colSums(Yc) / sum(Yc), colMeans(Yc / rowSums(Yc)))
  }
  step <- function(b) {
    unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) comp(g[sample.int(length(g), length(g), replace = TRUE)])),
           use.names = FALSE)
  }
  boot <- parallel_simulate(N_BOOT, step, SEED + 5500L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)),
                            2L * K * length(lev))
  types <- sub(paste0("^", ph, " "), "", o$type_labels)
  rows <- list()
  for (gi in seq_along(lev)) {
    est <- comp(groups[[gi]])
    for (w in 1:2) {
      cols <- (gi - 1L) * 2L * K + (w - 1L) * K + seq_len(K)
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        Phase = ph, Terrace_class = lev[gi],
        Weighting = c("Fragment-weighted", "Terrace-balanced")[w], Type = types,
        Percent = 100 * est[(w - 1L) * K + seq_len(K)],
        Low = 100 * apply(boot[, cols, drop = FALSE], 2, stats::quantile, .025),
        High = 100 * apply(boot[, cols, drop = FALSE], 2, stats::quantile, .975),
        Terraces = length(groups[[gi]]), Fragments = sum(Y[groups[[gi]], ]))
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

fig4d$Terrace_class <- factor(fig4d$Terrace_class, levels = CLASS_LEVELS)
fig4_plot <- fig4d[fig4d$Weighting == "Fragment-weighted", ]
```

```{r fig5-compute}
band_labels <- function(breaks) {
  lo <- breaks[-length(breaks)]; hi <- breaks[-1L]
  ifelse(is.infinite(hi), paste0(fmt_num(lo), "+"), paste0(fmt_num(lo), "-", fmt_num(hi)))
}
merge_bands <- function(dist_km, ii, jj, breaks) {
  repeat {
    band <- cut(dist_km, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE,
                labels = band_labels(breaks))
    ok <- vapply(levels(band), function(l) {
      w <- which(band == l)
      length(w) >= MIN_PAIRS_PER_BAND &&
        length(unique(c(ii[w], jj[w]))) >= MIN_TERRACES_PER_BAND
    }, logical(1))
    if (all(ok) || length(breaks) <= 3L) return(list(band = band, breaks = breaks))
    bad <- which(!ok)[1]
    breaks <- if (bad == length(ok)) breaks[-bad] else breaks[-(bad + 1L)]
  }
}
make_strata <- function(tot, k) {
  k <- max(1L, min(as.integer(k), floor(length(tot) / 4L)))
  if (k <= 1L) return(rep(1L, length(tot)))
  as.integer(cut(rank(tot, ties.method = "first"), breaks = k, labels = FALSE))
}
distance_test <- function(ph, o = phase_data[[ph]], n_perm = N_PERM, exclude_contiguous = FALSE) {
  keep <- which(rowSums(o$Y) >= MIN_N_DISTANCE)
  if (length(keep) < 8L) return(NULL)
  Y <- o$Y[keep, , drop = FALSE]; S <- nrow(Y); tot <- rowSums(Y)
  x <- o$meta$UTM_East[keep]; y <- o$meta$UTM_North[keep]
  pr <- utils::combn(S, 2); ii <- pr[1, ]; jj <- pr[2, ]
  jsv <- pair_js(Y, ii, jj)
  M <- matrix(0, S, S); M[cbind(ii, jj)] <- jsv; M[cbind(jj, ii)] <- jsv
  removed <- 0L
  if (exclude_contiguous) {
    ids <- o$meta$Terrace_ID[keep]
    contiguous <- OVERLAP_MATRIX[cbind(ids[ii], ids[jj])]
    removed <- sum(contiguous)
    ii <- ii[!contiguous]; jj <- jj[!contiguous]; jsv <- jsv[!contiguous]
  }
  dist_km <- sqrt((x[ii] - x[jj])^2 + (y[ii] - y[jj])^2) / 1000
  mb <- merge_bands(dist_km, ii, jj, DIST_BREAKS_KM)
  band <- droplevels(mb$band)
  all_labels <- band_labels(mb$breaks)
  groups <- split(seq_along(ii), band)
  strata <- make_strata(tot, PERM_STRATA)
  step <- function(b) {
    perm <- seq_len(S)
    for (g in unique(strata)) {
      w <- which(strata == g)
      perm[w] <- w[sample.int(length(w))]
    }
    d <- M[cbind(perm[ii], perm[jj])]
    vapply(groups, function(g) mean(d[g]), numeric(1))
  }
  sim <- parallel_simulate(n_perm, step, SEED + 6900L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)), length(groups))
  obs <- vapply(groups, function(g) mean(jsv[g]), numeric(1))
  expected <- colMeans(sim); sd_band <- pmax(apply(sim, 2, stats::sd), 1e-10)
  t_obs <- max(abs((obs - expected) / sd_band))
  t_sim <- apply(abs(sweep(sweep(sim, 2, expected, "-"), 2, sd_band, "/")), 1, max)
  bands <- data.frame(
    Phase = ph, Band = names(groups),
    Lower_km = mb$breaks[match(names(groups), all_labels)],
    Upper_km = mb$breaks[match(names(groups), all_labels) + 1L],
    Pairs = lengths(groups),
    Terraces = vapply(groups, function(g) length(unique(c(ii[g], jj[g]))), numeric(1)),
    Median_km = vapply(groups, function(g) stats::median(dist_km[g]), numeric(1)),
    Observed = obs, Perm_median = apply(sim, 2, stats::median),
    Perm_q025 = apply(sim, 2, stats::quantile, .025),
    Perm_q975 = apply(sim, 2, stats::quantile, .975),
    Z = (obs - expected) / sd_band)
  bands$Position <- position_in_range(bands$Observed, bands$Perm_q025, bands$Perm_q975)
  list(bands = bands,
       global = data.frame(Phase = ph, Terraces = S, Pairs = length(ii), Bands = length(groups),
                           Global_statistic = t_obs,
                           P = (1 + sum(t_sim >= t_obs)) / (n_perm + 1),
                           Contiguous_pairs_removed = removed))
}
fig5_res <- setNames(lapply(PHASES, distance_test), PHASES)
fig5d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fig5_res, function(x) x$bands))
rownames(fig5d) <- NULL
band_key <- unique(fig5d[, c("Band", "Lower_km", "Upper_km")])
band_key <- band_key[order(band_key$Lower_km, band_key$Upper_km), ]
fig5d$Band <- factor(fig5d$Band, levels = unique(band_key$Band))
fig5d$Phase <- phase_factor(fig5d$Phase)
fig5_global <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fig5_res, function(x) x$global))
rownames(fig5_global) <- NULL
fig5_global$Holm_P <- stats::p.adjust(fig5_global$P, "holm")
```

```{r cv-functions}
subset_phase <- function(o, min_n = 1L, standard_only = FALSE) {
  n <- rowSums(o$Y)
  keep <- which(n >= min_n)
  if (standard_only) keep <- keep[o$meta$Terrace_class[keep] == "Standard"]
  if (length(keep) < MIN_TERRACES_CV) return(NULL)
  meta <- o$meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]; rownames(meta) <- NULL
  list(phase = o$phase, Y = o$Y[keep, , drop = FALSE], meta = meta,
       type_labels = o$type_labels, n = length(keep))
}
make_blocks <- function(o) {
  xy <- cbind(o$meta$UTM_East, o$meta$UTM_North)
  nb <- max(2L * CV_FOLDS, min(CV_BLOCKS, floor(nrow(xy) / 3L)))
  for (attempt in 1:5) {
    set.seed(SEED + sum(utf8ToInt(o$phase)) + nrow(xy) + 104729L * (attempt - 1L))
    km <- tryCatch(stats::kmeans(xy, centers = nb, nstart = 25, iter.max = 200),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(km)) return(km$cluster)
  }
  stop("Spatial blocking failed for ", o$phase)
}
make_partitions <- function(blocks, phase, R, K = CV_FOLDS) {
  ub <- sort(unique(blocks))
  parts <- list(); keys <- character(); draws <- 0L
  while (length(parts) < R && draws < 100L * R) {
    draws <- draws + 1L
    set.seed(SEED + sum(utf8ToInt(phase)) + length(blocks) + 7919L * draws)
    fold_of_block <- sample(rep(seq_len(K), length.out = length(ub)))
    fd <- fold_of_block[match(blocks, ub)]
    key <- paste(match(fd, unique(fd)), collapse = "")
    if (key %in% keys) next
    keys <- c(keys, key)
    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- fd
  }
  if (length(parts) < R) stop("Could not draw ", R, " distinct partitions for ", phase)
  list(partitions = parts, draws = draws, blocks = length(ub))
}
cv_one_fold <- function(o, fd, k) {
  it <- which(fd != k); ie <- which(fd == k)
  trY <- o$Y[it, , drop = FALSE]; teY <- o$Y[ie, , drop = FALSE]
  a <- fit_m0(trY); b <- fit_dm(trY)
  b_ok <- !is.null(b) && isTRUE(b$converged)
  ft <- fit_dm_class(trY, o$meta$Terrace_class[it])
  mt <- predict_m1t(ft, if (b_ok) b else NULL, teY, o$meta$Terrace_class[ie])
  data.frame(Fold = k, Terrace_ID = o$meta$Terrace_ID[ie], Fragments = rowSums(teY),
             M0 = multinom_loglik_rows(teY, a$p),
             M1 = if (b_ok) dm_loglik_rows(teY, b$p, b$phi) else NA_real_,
             M1T = mt$ll, M1T_class_unseen = mt$unseen)
}
cv_compare <- function(d, a, b) {
  diff <- d[[a]] - d[[b]]; ok <- is.finite(diff); n <- sum(ok)
  frag <- sum(d$Fragments[ok])
  total <- if (n) sum(diff[ok]) else NA_real_
  se <- if (n > 1L) sqrt(n * stats::var(diff[ok])) else NA_real_
  data.frame(Total = total, SE_total = se, Terraces = n, Fragments = frag,
             Gain_per_fragment = if (frag > 0) total / frag else NA_real_,
             SE_per_fragment = if (frag > 0) se / frag else NA_real_)
}
```

```{r cv-run}
cv_jobs <- list(); cv_expected <- list(); cv_skipped <- list(); partition_audit <- list()
cv_store <- list()
for (ph in PHASES) for (s in seq_len(nrow(CV_SCENARIOS))) {
  sc <- CV_SCENARIOS[s, ]
  o <- subset_phase(phase_data[[ph]], sc$Min_n, sc$Standard_only)
  if (is.null(o)) {
    cv_skipped[[length(cv_skipped) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      Phase = ph, Scenario = sc$Scenario, Reason = paste("fewer than", MIN_TERRACES_CV, "terraces"))
    next
  }
  pp <- make_partitions(make_blocks(o), ph, CV_REPEATS)
  partition_audit[[length(partition_audit) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    Phase = ph, Scenario = sc$Scenario, Terraces = o$n, Blocks = pp$blocks,
    Distinct_partitions = length(pp$partitions), Draws = pp$draws)
  cv_expected[[paste(ph, sc$Scenario, sep = "|")]] <- c(terraces = o$n, fragments = sum(o$Y))
  cv_store[[paste(ph, sc$Scenario, sep = "|")]] <- list(o = o, partitions = pp$partitions)
  for (r in seq_along(pp$partitions)) {
    fd <- pp$partitions[[r]]
    for (k in sort(unique(fd))) {
      cv_jobs[[length(cv_jobs) + 1L]] <- list(o = o, fd = fd, k = k, phase = ph,
                                              scenario = sc$Scenario, repeat_id = r)
    }
  }
}
partition_audit <- do.call(rbind, partition_audit)
cv_skipped <- if (length(cv_skipped)) do.call(rbind, cv_skipped) else NULL
cv_rows <- parallel_map(cv_jobs, function(job) {
  d <- cv_one_fold(job$o, job$fd, job$k)
  d$Phase <- job$phase; d$Scenario <- job$scenario; d$Repeat <- job$repeat_id
  d
})
comparisons <- list(c("M1", "M0", "M1 minus M0"), c("M1T", "M1", "M1T minus M1"))
cv_rep <- NULL
cv_unseen <- NULL
for (ph in PHASES) for (sc in CV_SCENARIOS$Scenario) for (r in seq_len(CV_REPEATS)) {
  parts <- Filter(function(x) x$Phase[1] == ph && x$Scenario[1] == sc && x$Repeat[1] == r,
                  cv_rows)
  if (!length(parts)) next
  d <- do.call(rbind, parts)
  ex <- cv_expected[[paste(ph, sc, sep = "|")]]
  if (nrow(d) != ex[["terraces"]] || sum(d$Fragments) != ex[["fragments"]] ||
      anyDuplicated(d$Terrace_ID))
    stop("Fold accounting mismatch: ", ph, ", ", sc, ", partition ", r)
  cv_unseen <- rbind(cv_unseen, data.frame(Phase = ph, Scenario = sc, Repeat = r,
                                           Unseen = sum(d$M1T_class_unseen %in% TRUE),
                                           Held_out = nrow(d)))
  for (cmp in comparisons) {
    res <- cv_compare(d, cmp[1], cmp[2])
    if (res$Terraces == 0L) next
    cv_rep <- rbind(cv_rep, cbind(data.frame(Phase = ph, Scenario = sc, Repeat = r,
                                             Comparison = cmp[3]), res))
  }
}
cv_agg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  split(cv_rep, paste(cv_rep$Phase, cv_rep$Scenario, cv_rep$Comparison, sep = "|")),
  function(d) data.frame(
    Phase = d$Phase[1], Scenario = d$Scenario[1], Comparison = d$Comparison[1],
    Partitions = nrow(d), Mean_gain = mean(d$Gain_per_fragment),
    Min_gain = min(d$Gain_per_fragment), Max_gain = max(d$Gain_per_fragment),
    Mean_SE = mean(d$SE_per_fragment), Favouring_first = sum(d$Gain_per_fragment > 0),
    Terraces = d$Terraces[1], Fragments = d$Fragments[1])))
rownames(cv_agg) <- NULL
cv_agg <- cv_agg[order(phase_factor(cv_agg$Phase), match(cv_agg$Scenario, CV_SCENARIOS$Scenario),
                       cv_agg$Comparison), ]
```

```{r fig7-compute}
nn_check <- function(Y, nn, p, phi, B, seed) {
  obs <- nn_divergence(Y, nn)
  n <- rowSums(Y)
  step <- function(b) nn_divergence(sim_m1(n, p, phi), nn)
  sims <- as.numeric(parallel_simulate(B, step, seed, 1L))
  mu <- mean(sims); s <- stats::sd(sims)
  data.frame(Observed = obs, Null_mean = mu, Null_sd = s, SES = (obs - mu) / s,
             Ratio = obs / mu, Share_sims_at_or_below = mean(sims <= obs),
             Terraces = nrow(Y), Simulations = B)
}
robustness_phase <- function(ph) {
  o <- phase_data[[ph]]; f1 <- fits[[ph]]$M1
  x <- o$meta$UTM_East; y <- o$meta$UTM_North
  scen <- list()
  scen[["Nearest terrace"]] <- list(Y = o$Y, nn = nn_index(x, y, 1L), p = f1$p, phi = f1$phi)
  scen[["Three nearest terraces"]] <- list(Y = o$Y, nn = nn_index(x, y, 3L), p = f1$p,
                                           phi = f1$phi)
  for (spec in list(list(label = "Standard terraces only", min_n = 1L, std = TRUE),
                    list(label = "Terraces with 5+ fragments", min_n = 5L, std = FALSE))) {
    s <- subset_phase(o, spec$min_n, spec$std)
    if (is.null(s)) next
    fs <- fit_dm(s$Y)
    if (is.null(fs) || !isTRUE(fs$converged)) next
    scen[[spec$label]] <- list(Y = s$Y, nn = nn_index(s$meta$UTM_East, s$meta$UTM_North, 1L),
                               p = fs$p, phi = fs$phi)
  }
  rows <- list()
  for (k in seq_along(scen)) {
    sc <- scen[[k]]
    r <- nn_check(sc$Y, sc$nn, sc$p, sc$phi, N_SIM, SEED + 9200L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)) + 101L * k)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- cbind(data.frame(Phase = ph, Scenario = names(scen)[k]), r)
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
local_divergence <- function(Y, nn) {
  k <- ncol(nn)
  v <- pair_js(Y, rep(seq_len(nrow(Y)), each = k), as.vector(t(nn)))
  colMeans(matrix(v, nrow = k))
}
map_phase <- function(ph) {
  s <- subset_phase(phase_data[[ph]], MAP_MIN_N, FALSE)
  if (is.null(s)) return(NULL)
  fit <- fit_dm(s$Y)
  if (is.null(fit) || !isTRUE(fit$converged)) return(NULL)
  x <- s$meta$UTM_East; y <- s$meta$UTM_North
  nn <- nn_index(x, y, MAP_K)
  obs <- local_divergence(s$Y, nn)
  n <- rowSums(s$Y)
  step <- function(b) local_divergence(sim_m1(n, fit$p, fit$phi), nn)
  sims <- parallel_simulate(N_SIM, step, SEED + 9700L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)), nrow(s$Y))
  below <- colSums(sweep(sims, 2, obs, "<"))
  tied <- colSums(sweep(sims, 2, obs, "=="))
  percentile <- (below + 0.5 * tied + 0.5) / (N_SIM + 1)
  score <- stats::qnorm(percentile)
  dx <- matrix(x[nn], nrow = nrow(nn)) - x
  dy <- matrix(y[nn], nrow = nrow(nn)) - y
  mean_nd <- rowMeans(sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2))
  g <- rowMeans(sims)
  list(points = data.frame(Phase = ph, Terrace_ID = s$meta$Terrace_ID, X = x, Y = y,
                           Fragments = n, Observed = obs, Percentile = percentile,
                           Score = score, Mean_neighbour_distance_m = mean_nd),
       global = data.frame(Phase = ph, Terraces = nrow(s$Y), Observed = mean(obs),
                           Null_mean = mean(g), Null_sd = stats::sd(g),
                           SES = (mean(obs) - mean(g)) / stats::sd(g),
                           Share_sims_at_or_below = mean(g <= mean(obs)),
                           Lowest_2_5 = sum(percentile <= 0.025),
                           Highest_2_5 = sum(percentile >= 0.975),
                           Expected_each_tail = 0.025 * nrow(s$Y),
                           Capped = sum(abs(score) > MAP_Z_LIMIT),
                           Median_neighbour_distance_m = stats::median(mean_nd),
                           P90_neighbour_distance_m = stats::quantile(mean_nd, .9, names = FALSE)))
}

  o <- phase_data[[ph]]

}))
unscored$Panel <- factor(map_global$Panel[match(unscored$Phase, map_global$Phase)],
                         levels = panel_order)
ses_names <- c("Nearest terrace" = "Nearest, all terraces",
               "Three nearest terraces" = "Three nearest, all terraces",
               "Standard terraces only" = "Nearest, standard terraces",
               "Terraces with 5+ fragments" = "Nearest, 5+ fragments")
stopifnot(setequal(names(ses_names), NN_SCENARIOS))
ses_main <- "Three nearest, 5+ fragments (a)"
ses_d <- rbind(
  data.frame(Phase = map_global$Phase, Scenario = ses_main, SES = map_global$SES,
             Terraces = map_global$Terraces),
  data.frame(Phase = as.character(robust_d$Phase),
             Scenario = unname(ses_names[as.character(robust_d$Scenario)]),
             SES = robust_d$SES, Terraces = robust_d$Terraces))

map_pts <- map_pts[order(abs(map_pts$Score)), ]
bb <- as.numeric(sf::st_bbox(survey_union))
pad <- 0.05 * c(bb[3] - bb[1], bb[4] - bb[2])
xlim <- c(bb[1] - pad[1], bb[3] + pad[1]); ylim <- c(bb[2] - pad[2], bb[4] + pad[2])
u <- min(diff(xlim), diff(ylim))
corner_distance <- function(cx, cy) {
  as.numeric(sf::st_distance(sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(cx, cy)), crs = 32618), survey_union))
}
arrow_on_left <- corner_distance(xlim[1], ylim[2]) >= corner_distance(xlim[2], ylim[2])
bar_on_left <- corner_distance(xlim[1], ylim[1]) >= corner_distance(xlim[2], ylim[1])
nice_km <- c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10)
bar_km <- max(c(0.25, nice_km[nice_km <= 0.3 * diff(xlim) / 1000]))
bar_m <- 1000 * bar_km
bh <- 0.02 * u
x0 <- if (bar_on_left) xlim[1] + 0.05 * diff(xlim) else xlim[2] - 0.05 * diff(xlim) - bar_m
y0 <- ylim[1] + 0.05 * diff(ylim)
scale_black <- data.frame(xmin = x0, xmax = x0 + bar_m / 2, ymin = y0, ymax = y0 + bh)
scale_white <- data.frame(xmin = x0 + bar_m / 2, xmax = x0 + bar_m, ymin = y0, ymax = y0 + bh)
scale_text <- data.frame(x = c(x0, x0 + bar_m), y = y0 + bh + 0.04 * u,
                         label = c("0", paste(fmt_num(bar_km), "km")), hjust = c(0, 1))
xa <- if (arrow_on_left) xlim[1] + 0.08 * diff(xlim) else xlim[2] - 0.08 * diff(xlim)
ytop <- ylim[2] - 0.07 * diff(ylim)
aw <- 0.04 * u; ah <- 0.13 * u; notch <- 0.04 * u
arrow_left <- data.frame(x = c(xa, xa - aw, xa), y = c(ytop, ytop - ah, ytop - ah + notch))
arrow_right <- data.frame(x = c(xa, xa + aw, xa), y = c(ytop, ytop - ah, ytop - ah + notch))
arrow_text <- data.frame(x = xa, y = ytop + 0.05 * u, label = "N")
survey_sf <- sf::st_sf(geometry = survey_union)
panel_width_mm <- (FIG_WIDTH_MM - 12) / 3
MAP_HEIGHT_MM <- min(234 - FIG7B_HEIGHT_MM, panel_width_mm * diff(ylim) / diff(xlim) + 34)
```

```{r table1-build}
table1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(PHASES, function(ph) {

               counts[["Large"]], " large)"),

      `95% bootstrap interval` = if (nrow(b) && is.finite(b$Concentration_q025))

      `Intraclass correlation` = paste0(fmt_num(1 / (1 + mle), 3),
        if (nrow(b) && is.finite(b$ICC_q025))
          paste0(" (", interval_text(b$ICC_q025, b$ICC_q975, 3), ")") else ""),
      `Bootstrap fits converged` = if (nrow(b)) paste(b$Converged, "of", b$Bootstrap_fits) else "NA",
      check.names = FALSE)
  }))
}))
```

```{r table2-build}
held_out_agreement <- function(ph, comparison, first_preferred) {
  d <- cv_rep[cv_rep$Phase == ph & cv_rep$Scenario == CV_SCENARIOS$Scenario[1] &
                cv_rep$Comparison == comparison & is.finite(cv_rep$Total), ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return("not available")
  paste(sum((d$Total > 0) == first_preferred), "of", nrow(d), "partitions")
}
table2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(PHASES, function(ph) {
  o <- phase_data[[ph]]; f <- fits[[ph]]
  aic <- c(M0 = f$M0$aic, M1 = f$M1$aic %||% NA_real_, M1T = f$M1T$aic %||% NA_real_)
  npar <- c(M0 = f$M0$npar, M1 = f$M1$npar %||% NA_real_, M1T = f$M1T$npar %||% NA_real_)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(list(c("M1", "M0"), c("M1T", "M1")), function(cmp) {
    d_aic <- aic[[cmp[2]]] - aic[[cmp[1]]]
    first_pref <- is.finite(d_aic) && d_aic > 0
    data.frame(
      Phase = ph, Comparison = paste(cmp[1], "vs", cmp[2]),
      `Likelihood units` = paste(o$n, "terraces"),
      `Extra parameters` = fmt_num(npar[[cmp[1]]] - npar[[cmp[2]]]),
      `Delta AIC` = fmt_num(round(d_aic, 2), 7),
      `In-sample preference` = if (!is.finite(d_aic)) "not available" else
        if (first_pref) cmp[1] else cmp[2],
      `Held-out agreement` = held_out_agreement(ph, paste(cmp[1], "minus", cmp[2]), first_pref),
      check.names = FALSE)
  }))
}))
rownames(table2) <- NULL
stopifnot(nrow(table2) == 6L, ncol(table2) == 7L)
```

```{r sensitivity-functions}
subset_rows <- function(o, keep) {
  meta <- o$meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]; rownames(meta) <- NULL
  list(phase = o$phase, Y = o$Y[keep, , drop = FALSE], meta = meta,
       type_labels = o$type_labels, n = length(keep))
}
rarefy_counts <- function(y, m) {
  pool <- rep(seq_along(y), y)
  tabulate(pool[sample.int(length(pool), m)], nbins = length(y))
}
rarefied_distance <- function(ph) {
  o <- phase_data[[ph]]
  keep <- which(rowSums(o$Y) >= RAREFY_N)
  if (length(keep) < 8L) return(NULL)
  Y0 <- o$Y[keep, , drop = FALSE]; S <- nrow(Y0)
  x <- o$meta$UTM_East[keep]; y <- o$meta$UTM_North[keep]
  pr <- utils::combn(S, 2); ii <- pr[1, ]; jj <- pr[2, ]
  dist_km <- sqrt((x[ii] - x[jj])^2 + (y[ii] - y[jj])^2) / 1000
  band <- droplevels(merge_bands(dist_km, ii, jj, DIST_BREAKS_KM)$band)
  groups <- split(seq_along(ii), band)
  m_each <- RAREFY_N; n_perm <- RAREFY_PERMS
  step <- function(r) {
    Yr <- t(apply(Y0, 1, rarefy_counts, m = m_each))
    jsv <- pair_js(Yr, ii, jj)
    M <- matrix(0, S, S); M[cbind(ii, jj)] <- jsv; M[cbind(jj, ii)] <- jsv
    obs <- vapply(groups, function(g) mean(jsv[g]), numeric(1))
    sim <- t(vapply(seq_len(n_perm), function(b) {
      perm <- sample.int(S)
      d <- M[cbind(perm[ii], perm[jj])]
      vapply(groups, function(g) mean(d[g]), numeric(1))
    }, numeric(length(groups))))
    ex <- colMeans(sim); sdv <- pmax(apply(sim, 2, stats::sd), 1e-10)
    t_obs <- max(abs((obs - ex) / sdv))
    t_sim <- apply(abs(sweep(sweep(sim, 2, ex, "-"), 2, sdv, "/")), 1, max)
    c(t_obs, (1 + sum(t_sim >= t_obs)) / (n_perm + 1), (obs[1] - ex[1]) / sdv[1])
  }
  res <- parallel_simulate(RAREFY_REPS, step, SEED + 12100L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)), 3L)
  data.frame(Phase = ph, Terraces = S, Median_global_statistic = stats::median(res[, 1]),
             Median_p = stats::median(res[, 2]), Share_p_below_0_05 = mean(res[, 2] < 0.05),
             Median_z_first_band = stats::median(res[, 3]), First_band = names(groups)[1])
}
map_ses <- function(o, B, seed, mask_contiguous = FALSE) {
  s <- subset_phase(o, MAP_MIN_N, FALSE)
  if (is.null(s)) return(NA_real_)
  fit <- fit_dm(s$Y)
  if (is.null(fit) || !isTRUE(fit$converged)) return(NA_real_)
  x <- s$meta$UTM_East; y <- s$meta$UTM_North
  d <- sqrt(outer(x, x, "-")^2 + outer(y, y, "-")^2)
  diag(d) <- Inf
  if (mask_contiguous) d[OVERLAP_MATRIX[s$meta$Terrace_ID, s$meta$Terrace_ID]] <- Inf
  nn <- t(apply(d, 1, function(r) order(r)[seq_len(MAP_K)]))
  nn_check(s$Y, nn, fit$p, fit$phi, B, seed)$SES
}
fit_dm_size <- function(Y, s, maxit = 3000L) {
  if (nrow(Y) < 5L || ncol(Y) < 2L) return(NULL)
  K <- ncol(Y); J <- K - 1L
  p0 <- (colSums(Y) + 0.5) / (sum(Y) + 0.5 * K)
  start <- c(log(p0[-K] / p0[K]), rep(0, J), log(12))
  fn <- function(z) {
    P <- size_composition(list(a = z[seq_len(J)], b = z[J + seq_len(J)]), s)
    v <- sum(dm_loglik_rows_P(Y, P, exp(z[2L * J + 1L])))
    if (!is.finite(v)) 1e100 else -v
  }
  f <- tryCatch(stats::optim(start, fn, method = "L-BFGS-B",
                             lower = c(rep(-14, J), rep(-10, J), log(.03)),
                             upper = c(rep(14, J), rep(10, J), log(1e7)),
                             control = list(maxit = maxit)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
  ll <- -f$value; npar <- 2L * J + 1L
  list(a = f$par[seq_len(J)], b = f$par[J + seq_len(J)], phi = exp(f$par[2L * J + 1L]),
       ll = ll, npar = npar, aic = -2 * ll + 2 * npar, converged = f$convergence == 0L)
}
size_composition <- function(fit, s) {
  J <- length(fit$a)
  eta <- cbind(matrix(fit$a, length(s), J, byrow = TRUE) + outer(s, fit$b), 0)
  eta <- eta - apply(eta, 1, max)
  E <- exp(eta)
  E / rowSums(E)
}
cv_size_fold <- function(o, fd, k) {
  it <- which(fd != k); ie <- which(fd == k)
  trY <- o$Y[it, , drop = FALSE]; teY <- o$Y[ie, , drop = FALSE]
  b <- fit_dm(trY); fz <- fit_dm_size(trY, o$size_dev[it])
  ok <- !is.null(b) && isTRUE(b$converged) && !is.null(fz) && isTRUE(fz$converged)
  data.frame(Fragments = rowSums(teY),
             M1 = if (ok) dm_loglik_rows(teY, b$p, b$phi) else NA_real_,
             M1D = if (ok) dm_loglik_rows_P(teY, size_composition(fz, o$size_dev[ie]), fz$phi)
                   else NA_real_)
}
```

```{r sensitivity-run}
sens_rarefied <- do.call(rbind, lapply(PHASES, rarefied_distance))
sens_score <- do.call(rbind, lapply(PHASES, function(ph) {
  d <- map_pts[map_pts$Phase == ph, ]
  data.frame(Phase = ph, Terraces = nrow(d),
             Spearman_score_fragments = stats::cor(d$Score, d$Fragments, method = "spearman"),
             Spearman_score_neighbour_distance = stats::cor(d$Score, d$Mean_neighbour_distance_m,
                                                            method = "spearman"))
}))
set.seed(SEED + 515L)
region_fit <- stats::kmeans(cbind(terraces$UTM_East, terraces$UTM_North), centers = LOO_REGIONS,
                            nstart = 50, iter.max = 200)
REGION_OF_TERRACE <- setNames(region_fit$cluster, terraces$Terrace_ID)
loo_rows <- list()
for (ph in PHASES) for (r in seq_len(LOO_REGIONS)) {
  o <- phase_data[[ph]]
  s <- subset_rows(o, which(REGION_OF_TERRACE[o$meta$Terrace_ID] != r))
  f0 <- fit_m0(s$Y); f1 <- fit_dm(s$Y); ft <- fit_dm_class(s$Y, s$meta$Terrace_class)
  dt <- distance_test(ph, o = s, n_perm = LOO_PERMS)
  loo_rows[[length(loo_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    Phase = ph, Region_left_out = r, Terraces = s$n, Fragments = sum(s$Y),
    M1_vs_M0_dAIC_per_fragment = (f0$aic - (f1$aic %||% NA_real_)) / sum(s$Y),
    M1T_vs_M1_dAIC = (f1$aic %||% NA_real_) - (ft$aic %||% NA_real_),
    Map_SES = map_ses(s, LOO_SIMS, SEED + 13300L + 17L * r + sum(utf8ToInt(ph))),
    Fig5_P = if (is.null(dt)) NA_real_ else dt$global$P)
}
sens_loo <- do.call(rbind, loo_rows)
sens_contiguous <- do.call(rbind, lapply(PHASES, function(ph) {
  dt <- distance_test(ph, exclude_contiguous = TRUE)
  g <- fig5_global[fig5_global$Phase == ph, ]
  data.frame(Phase = ph,
             Map_SES_main = map_global$SES[map_global$Phase == ph],
             Map_SES_without_contiguous_neighbours = map_ses(phase_data[[ph]], N_SIM,
               SEED + 14400L + sum(utf8ToInt(ph)), mask_contiguous = TRUE),
             Fig5_statistic_main = g$Global_statistic, Fig5_P_main = g$P,
             Fig5_statistic_without_contiguous_pairs = dt$global$Global_statistic,
             Fig5_P_without_contiguous_pairs = dt$global$P,
             Fig5_pairs_removed = dt$global$Contiguous_pairs_removed)
}))
size_median <- stats::median(terraces$Diam_Terra)
size_raw <- abs(log(terraces$Diam_Terra) - log(size_median))
size_scale <- stats::sd(size_raw)
size_jobs <- list(); size_insample <- list(); size_fits <- list()
for (ph in PHASES) {
  st <- cv_store[[paste(ph, CV_SCENARIOS$Scenario[1], sep = "|")]]
  o <- st$o
  o$size_dev <- abs(log(o$meta$Diam_Terra) - log(size_median)) / size_scale
  f1 <- fit_dm(o$Y); fz <- fit_dm_size(o$Y, o$size_dev)
  size_fits[[ph]] <- fz
  size_insample[[ph]] <- data.frame(Phase = ph, Delta_AIC_vs_M1 = f1$aic - (fz$aic %||% NA_real_),
                                    Extra_parameters = (fz$npar %||% NA_real_) - f1$npar,
                                    Converged = isTRUE(fz$converged))
  for (r in seq_along(st$partitions)) {
    fd <- st$partitions[[r]]
    for (k in sort(unique(fd))) size_jobs[[length(size_jobs) + 1L]] <-
      list(o = o, fd = fd, k = k, phase = ph, repeat_id = r)
  }
}
size_rows <- parallel_map(size_jobs, function(job) {
  d <- cv_size_fold(job$o, job$fd, job$k)
  d$Phase <- job$phase; d$Repeat <- job$repeat_id
  d
})
size_cv <- do.call(rbind, size_rows)
sens_size <- do.call(rbind, lapply(PHASES, function(ph) {
  d <- size_cv[size_cv$Phase == ph, ]
  per_rep <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, d$Repeat), function(x)
    cbind(data.frame(Repeat = x$Repeat[1]), cv_compare(x, "M1D", "M1"))))
  cbind(size_insample[[ph]],
        data.frame(Held_out_mean_gain = mean(per_rep$Gain_per_fragment),
                   Held_out_mean_SE = mean(per_rep$SE_per_fragment),
                   Partitions_favouring_M1D = sum(per_rep$Gain_per_fragment > 0),
                   Partitions = nrow(per_rep)))
}))
```
